ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate >90% of the fluke surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to localized clusters and edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark field with high-contrast white mottle blobs on the distal tips of both lobes; scattered white focal spots across the central fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees; moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; micro-peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes of 2-7 pixels, appearing most jagged on the medial-to-distal sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch to the tips, ending in a slightly recurved, tapered distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-intensity circular pixel clusters (barnacle scars) located on the right distal tip and lower central-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 30% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white trailing-edge margin on the right lobe compared to the more uniform dark edge on the left lobe.
